title: Why is it low power? · ET-SoC-1
description: Esperanto's equation, power = C V^2 f + leakage, measured term by term on a real card and set against an A100: a third of the voltage-squared, roughly half the clock, fine-grained clock gating, a 23 W leakage floor at 80 °C, and 14–28 times fewer FLOPs per second. Per FLOP, the A100's bf16 tensor cores still spend less energy.
